rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.003, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=adam, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-10 OPTIMIZER pivot. Lambda peak located and shallow: lambda 2e-3->0.3552, 3e-3->0.3596 (BEST), 4e-3->0.3336; further lambda bisection is sub-0.005 noise-floor. Data term converged by ~iter450 while TV term still descended at iter-1000 in earlier GD logs => the TV minimum may be under-converged by plain GD. ONE knob: tv_optimizer gd->adam (keep lambda=3e-3, 1000 iters, lr=0.01, gamma=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: Adam's adaptive per-parameter steps reach a deeper TV minimum than plain GD in the same 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.3596; if Adam overshoots/destabilizes (hr drops) GD was better and I revert then tune lr. Watch: adam at lr=0.01 may be aggressive. Budget: ~870s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
